scientific.integrity: The defining NosAdam weighted-average identity is specialized to one isolated squared-gradient outlier. The finite-time formula is exact, and the three regimes follow from the standard partial-sum asymptotics of the hyperharmonic weights.
limitations: First-moment momentum and full parameter dynamics are not classified.
The gamma-greater-than-one statement is a denominator-memory result, not a full-optimizer convergence claim.

title: NosAdam-HH has a sharp outlier-forgetting transition at \(\gamma=1\)
